question: On published flattened surface-volume renders (voxel-matched, level 2, middle slice), are texture-continuity breaks (1 - structure-tensor coherence) enriched near real windcheck-v0.3.2 self-crossing contacts vs spatially shifted zones in the same segment?

design.null: 1000 within-segment spatial shifts (|shift|>10 cells, shifted zone >=50% of |Z|)
design.primary: S = mean_B(zone) - mean_B(rest), b = 1 - coherence (sigma_d=1, sigma_i=3 px)
design.decision: Fisher combined p<0.05 AND z>0 in >= half of segments

heldout.secondary_confirmation_rule: Addendum A1 (written before held-out scoring): Fisher pI<0.05 AND zI>0 in >= half

confounds: scroll mix: pilot darkening large in PHerc0172 and ~null in PHerc0814; held-out has no PHerc0814
segment-family mix: 9/19 held-out segments are one auto_grown parent run (null); strong darkening only in some hand-named wNNN flatboi segments
mesh/zone size varies 22 to 203,663 zone cells
single middle slice at level 2, fixed sigma; structure-tensor metrics are resolution-dependent (sheetcheck caveat)
data: vesuvius-challenge-open-data (CC BY-NC 4.0) + windcheck v0.3.2 witness contacts; no payloads redistributed
